```python
def place_on_zone_v1(obj_name, zone_name):
    candidates = grasp_candidates(obj_name)
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError(f"No grasp candidates found for {obj_name}")
    
    # Select grasp candidate with fingers aligned along the long axis (yaw ≈ object_long_axis_yaw)
    candidate = next(c for c in candidates if abs(c["yaw"] - c["object_long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1)
    if not candidate:
        candidate = candidates[0]
    
    # Use grasp height at the center of the pen (0.006 m above table)
    grasp_height = 0.006
    candidate["height"] = grasp_height
    
    grasp(candidate)
    
    # Check if the object is now held
    if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp the object")
    
    # Find free spots on the target zone
    spots = free_spots(zone_name, obj_name)
    if not spots or not spots["spots"]:
        raise ValueError(f"No free spots found on {zone_name} for {obj_name}")
    
    spot = spots["spots"][0]
    target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]
    gripper_yaw_at_grasp = candidate["yaw"]
    object_long_axis_at_grasp = candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
    
    # Compute required gripper yaw during carry to achieve correct object orientation
    delta_yaw = target_yaw - object_long_axis_at_grasp + gripper_yaw_at_grasp
    carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=delta_yaw)
    
    # Lower until contact is made
    lower_until_contact()
    
    # Release the object
    open_gripper()
    
    # Retreat from the zone
    retreat()
    
    # Verify placement
    check(obj_name, zone_name)

place_on_zone_v1("yellow_pen", "green_case")
```
